title: Images and videos
intro: Your creations, and the models that compute them, here or on your machines that lend their computing power.
ask: To create an image or a video, ask for it in a chat: “Create an image of a lighthouse in a storm”, or press {icon} next to the message to choose the model, the format and how many.

engine_no_helpers: Without it, only your machines that have the model can compute.
